title: Puaka Hari Raya
overview: Fahmi disobeyed his mother and ran away from the village on the eve of Eid. After several years, he returned to his village. However, what awaited him was a 'ghost' that kidnapped young children as a replacement for missing Fahmi. His mother, Fatimah, who passed away alone on the eve of Eid, haunted the children every Eid night because she missed her son.
